set-variable.value: #[{category: 'FUNCTIONAL', code: 'BAD_REQUEST', message: vars.errorMessage default 'Invalid request.', retryable: false}]
#[{category: 'FUNCTIONAL', code: 'PROPERTY_NOT_FOUND', message: vars.errorMessage default 'Property not found.', retryable: false}]
#[{category: 'TECHNICAL', code: 'UPSTREAM_DATA_INVALID', message: vars.errorMessage default 'The property data could not be read.', retryable: false}]
#[{category: 'TECHNICAL', code: 'DOWNSTREAM_TIMEOUT', message: 'The booking search service timed out. Retry later.', retryable: true}]
#[{category: 'TECHNICAL', code: 'DOWNSTREAM_UNAVAILABLE', message: 'The booking search service failed. Contact support with the correlation ID.', retryable: true}]
#[{category: 'TECHNICAL', code: 'INTERNAL_ERROR', message: 'Request failed. Contact support with the correlation ID.', retryable: false}]

logger.message: #[output text/plain --- if (error.errorType.namespace == "HTTP") write({event: "xapi.downstream.error", correlationId: vars.traceId default correlationId, status: error.errorMessage.attributes.statusCode default null, detail: error.description, body: do { var b = (if (error.errorMessage.payload is String) error.errorMessage.payload else write(error.errorMessage.payload default "", "application/json", {indent: false})) as String --- if (sizeOf(b) > 1000) b[0 to 999] else b }}, "application/json", {indent: false}) else ""]
#[output text/plain --- write({event: "xapi.downstream.error", correlationId: vars.traceId default correlationId, detail: error.description}, "application/json", {indent: false})]

#[output text/plain --- write({event: "xapi.failure", tool: "get_property_details", correlationId: vars.traceId default correlationId, status: vars.httpStatus, code: vars.publicError.code, errorType: error.errorType.namespace ++ ":" ++ error.errorType.identifier, detail: error.description}, "application/json", {indent: false})]

set-payload.value: #[output application/json --- {success: false, correlationId: vars.traceId default correlationId, error: vars.publicError}]
